title: Lusin compact exhaustion of a rectifiable varifold's carrier (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1))
statement: Let n, ℓ ≥ 0, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open, and V = v(M, θ) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure RectifiableVarifold; M = V.carrier, θ = V.mult). Then there are compact sets K_m ⊆ M (m ∈ ℕ) such that θ is continuous on each K_m, Hⁿ(K_m) < ∞, and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_m K_m) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]). (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(1), first assertion.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), ∃ K : ℕ → Set (Amb n ℓ), (∀ m, IsCompact (K m)) ∧ (∀ m, K m ⊆ V.carrier) ∧ (∀ m, ContinuousOn V.mult (K m)) ∧ (∀ m, (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (K m) < ⊤) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.carrier \ ⋃ m, K m) = 0
